description: K₅NaS₄(O₆Cl)₂ crystallizes in the tetragonal P4/mnc space group. There are two inequivalent K sites. In the first K site, K is bonded in a distorted q6 geometry to eight equivalent O and two equivalent Cl atoms. All K-O bond lengths are 3.19 Å. Both K-Cl bond lengths are 3.06 Å. In the second K site, K is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to six O and two equivalent Cl atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.83-3.15 Å. Both K-Cl bond lengths are 3.10 Å. Na is bonded in an octahedral geometry to four equivalent O and two equivalent Cl atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.32 Å. Both Na-Cl bond lengths are 2.72 Å. S is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.45 Å) and two longer (1.46 Å) S-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three K and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent K, one Na, and one S atom. Cl is bonded to five K and one Na atom to form corner-sharing ClK₅Na octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-30°.
